meta.title: Ohana
meta.description: One app for the whole family: calendar, finance, meals, doctor appointments and an assistant.

roles.editorHint: can change everything and add people

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.soon: The assistant will look things up, plan and change things in every part of Ohana. It arrives with the calendar and the finances.
assistant.noFamily: The assistant works in a family: create one or open yours.
assistant.queueWait: Just a moment, the chat is starting.
assistant.placeholderQueue: Next message – sent once this answer is done…
assistant.setupFirst: Set up the assistant in the settings first
assistant.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line. Paste or attach screenshots and files.
assistant.attachUnsupported: Can't attach “{{name}}”: only images and text files (like .txt, .csv, .json) are supported.
assistant.attachCut: “{{name}}” is long: only the first 50,000 characters are sent.
assistant.imageGone: The image is no longer stored.
assistant.setupText: Connect any OpenAI-compatible AI (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Mistral, Gemini, a local model …) in the settings. It can then look things up on the web and plan in your calendar and finances.
assistant.setupViewer: Nobody has set up the assistant for this family yet. Ask an editor of the family to do it in the settings.
assistant.intro: Ask me anything about your family's plans, for example:

example.gaps: Which days this year still need cover, and who could take them?
example.holidays: Look up next year's public holidays here and add them to the calendar.
example.spending: How much did we spend on groceries this year, per month?
example.uncategorized: Sort our uncategorized transactions into categories.
example.types: Set up this year's entry types: day care closed, each parent's vacation and public holidays.
example.categories: Suggest categories for our finances and add them.
example.planWithout: Plan next week's meals without fish.
example.shopping: What's still on the shopping list? Add 2 l of milk.
example.dermatologist: Find a dermatologist appointment before June.
example.earliest: Which searches found something, and what is the earliest slot?

question.pickOne: Pick one, or write your own answer
question.pickSeveral: Pick one or more, or write your own answer

copy.chat: Copy the chat, with all tool results
copy.answer: Copy the answer, with all tool results

status.retrying: The model didn't answer – trying again ({{n}}/{{max}})…

assistant.compacted: Earlier messages condensed for the model
assistant.contextHelp: How much of the model's context window this chat uses. Before it is full, older messages are condensed into a summary, so long tasks can go on.

modules.calendar: Vacation, public holidays, sick days and day-care closures, with a coverage check and a calendar feed.
modules.finance: Transactions, accounts, categories, bank statement import and monthly overviews.
modules.meals: Recipes, meal plans that share ingredients, shopping lists and a cooking view.
modules.appointments: Watches Doctolib and jameda and tells you when an appointment frees up.
modules.soonText: This part of Ohana isn't there yet. Until then, keep using the app you use today.

appointments.runQueued: Queued: the search runs in a few seconds.
appointments.notRunYet: Not run yet: results appear after the first run.
appointments.noSlots: No bookable appointments in the latest run.
appointments.historyHint: Every run of this search with what it found. Runs older than 30 days are deleted.
appointments.deleteConfirm: Delete the search "{{name}}" with its history?

ignored.title: Ignore list
ignored.hint: Doctors (with their reason for the visit) this search skips. Ignore one from its appointment page.

form.description: Ohana checks Doctolib and jameda on the schedule you choose and notifies you about new appointments.
form.name: Name
form.notifyOnlyEarlier: Only notify when an appointment is earlier than the earliest seen so far
form.channelsHint: Where new appointments of this search are sent.
form.noChannels: Your family has no notification channels yet.

slot.subtitle: Title
slot.ignoreHint: Skip this doctor with this reason for the visit in this search from now on

booking.title: Booked this appointment?
booking.hint: Book it on the practice's page first. Ohana then shows it in the calendar (and in the calendar feed, if you subscribed with booked appointments).
booking.stopHint: Turns the search off; you can turn it on again when editing it.
booking.removeConfirm: Remove this appointment from Ohana? This doesn't cancel it with the practice.

booked.title: Booked appointments
booked.hint: Slots you marked as booked; they show in the calendar.

channels.title: Notifications
channels.hint: Where Ohana sends news for the family, e.g. a newly free appointment. Tokens and passwords are stored encrypted.
channels.formHint: Pushbullet, Pushover, Telegram or email over SMTP.
channels.name: Name
channels.tokenSet: A token is stored; leave the field empty to keep it.
channels.deleteConfirm: Delete the channel "{{name}}"? Searches stop sending to it.

coverage.title_one: {{count}} day without cover in the next two weeks
coverage.title_other: {{count}} days without cover in the next two weeks

events.title: What Ohana tells you
events.hint: Which news go to the channels below. Each message is sent once; nothing repeats every day.
events.appointment_foundHint: When a search finds a new or earlier appointment. Each search chooses its channels.
events.coverage_gapHint: In the morning, when a weekday in the next two weeks needs cover (e.g. a day-care closure) and nobody covers it yet.
events.shopping_reminderHint: In the evening before a shopping day: what is still on its list.
events.assistant_turn_finishedHint: When the assistant worked on a request for a while (30 seconds or more) and the chat isn't open anywhere.

homeAddress.title: Home address
homeAddress.hint: Where the family lives: appointments show how far a practice is from here.

home.intro: Everything your family plans, in one place.
home.noFamilyText: Create a family, or ask someone to add you to theirs (with the email of your account) or to send you an invite link.
home.noSearches: No searches yet: Ohana can watch Doctolib and jameda for you.

families.newDescription: You become its editor and can add the others afterwards.

settings.title: Settings
settings.viewerNote: You are a viewer in this family: you can look at everything but not change it.
settings.addMemberHint: For someone without an account, like a child. You can create an invite link for them now or later.
settings.invitesHint: The link lets someone join the family, with a new account or their existing one. Valid for 7 days, once.
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave {{family}}? You won't see it anymore unless someone adds you again.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete {{family}} with everything in it? This can't be undone.
settings.deleteHint: Only possible when you are the last member.

data.exportHelp: The whole family as a JSON file: the calendar of all years (entry types, entries, notes) and the finances (accounts, categories, transactions, settings). Viewers can export too.
data.importHelp: Replaces the calendar (all years) and the finances of this family with those of an exported file; the name, the members and the links stay. The finance page shows the imported finances the next time it opens. Can't be undone – export first to keep a copy.
data.invalid: This isn't a family export (a .json file from Settings → Data → Export).
data.confirm: Replace the calendar and the finances of “{{name}}” with the contents of “{{file}}”? All years, entry types, entries, notes and finances are overwritten; the name, the members and the links stay. This can't be undone.
data.waitSaving: Changes are still being saved – try again in a moment.

settings.withInvite: Create an invite link so they can sign in
settings.addByEmail: Has an Ohana account already? Add by email

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.passkeysHint: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. Add one per device.
account.noPassword: No password: you sign in with passkeys only.
account.passwordUpdated: Password saved. Your other devices were signed out.
account.resetBanner: You signed in with a setup link: set a new password or add a passkey now.
account.apiTokensHint: For scripts and AI agents: send as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". A token can do everything you can.
account.tokenCreated: Copy the token now: it won't be shown again.

admin.title: Administration
admin.newUserHint: The new account comes with a one-time setup link (7 days): it signs the person in and asks for a passkey or a password.
admin.name: Name
admin.userCreated: User created. Send them the setup link:

admin.deleteUserConfirm: Delete the account of {{name}}? Their families stay.
admin.familiesHint: Being an administrator doesn't open a family: add yourself as a member for that.
admin.deleteFamilyConfirm: Delete {{family}} with everything in it? This can't be undone.

invite.title: Invite

invite.createAccountDescription: Create an account to join this family.
invite.forPerson: You were added to the family as {{name}}.

credentials.title: How do you want to sign in?

types.title: Entry types
types.yearNote: These types belong to {{year}} – every year has its own. Changes are saved immediately.
types.copyFromTitle: Start {{to}} with the types of {{from}}; you can change them afterwards
types.copyOtherHint: Adds the types of that year that {{year}} doesn't have yet.
types.helpNeeds: Needs cover – e.g. “Day care closed”. A weekday with this entry and nothing that covers it is flagged as a gap.
types.helpCovers: Covers – e.g. “Vacation Dad”. Covers a “needs cover” day.
types.helpDayOff: Day off – e.g. “Holiday”. Covers everything and doesn't count as a used vacation day.
types.helpNone: Normal – just a color, no coverage logic.
types.name: Name
types.confirmDeleteUsed: Delete “{{name}}”? It is used on {{days}} in {{year}}. This can't be undone.
types.readonly: Only editors of the family can change entry types.
types.awayTitle: The whole family is away from home on these days: the meal plan plans no meals for them
types.helpAway: Away (checkbox, any role) – the whole family is away from home: the meal plan leaves these days out.

note.title: Icon & note
note.replaceHint: The selected days have different notes – saving replaces them.

help.title: How the calendar works
help.tapDo: Select a day; tap another day to move the selection
help.rangeDo: Tap a start day, then “Range”, then the end day
help.multiDo: Turn it on, then tap days to add or remove them; long-press + drag adds a range
help.clickDo: Select a day / a range of days (across months)
help.ctrlDo: Add single days to the selection
help.typeDo: Toggle that entry on the selected days (a day can have several)
help.copyDo: Copy / cut / paste. Pasting onto a larger selection repeats the copied days to fill it.
help.handleDo: Repeat the selected days forwards or backwards
help.noteDo: Add an icon or comment to the selected days
help.zoomDo: Zoom the calendar in / out (fewer or more days at once) / reset
help.gapDo: Jump to the next day that still needs cover
help.question: <kbd>?</kbd>

view.title: Calendar view
view.weekdaysTitle: Show the weekday letters on the days at every zoom level
view.skipWeekendsTitle: Weekends are left out when filling, pasting or toggling ranges

feed.title: Calendar subscription
feed.help: The only link that works without signing in: it opens the calendar feed, nothing else.
feed.icloudHelp: A read-only calendar feed. Apple Calendar checks it for changes regularly (choose “Every hour” or “Every 5 minutes” when subscribing on a Mac).
feed.rotateConfirm: Make a new feed address? Calendar subscriptions with the current one stop updating and need to be added again.
feed.howto: How to add it to iCloud
feed.howtoIos: iPhone / iPad: tap “Subscribe on this device” above (or Settings → Apps → Calendar → Calendar Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar, and paste the URL).
feed.howtoMac: Mac: Calendar → File → New Calendar Subscription…, paste the URL, set Location to iCloud so it syncs to all your devices, and pick an auto-refresh interval.
feed.howtoSync: A subscription stored in iCloud (Mac, Location “iCloud”) appears on all your Apple devices and on iCloud.com.
feed.legacyHelp: The feed address of this family in family-planner. Its event ids live on, so subscriptions moved over keep their events.
feed.legacyConfirm: Remove the old calendar link? Calendar subscriptions made with it stop updating.
feed.eventsTitle: Timed events such as booked doctor's appointments; they name the doctor and the practice

overview.nothing: Nothing planned for the next weeks.

finance.categoriesHelp: Used to sort transactions. Income categories show for money coming in, expense categories for money going out, “both” for either. Categories can have subcategories, as deep as you like: a subcategory has the kind of its top category, and a category's totals include its subcategories.
finance.empty: No transactions in this period. Add one or import a bank statement (CSV).
finance.noData: No transactions in this period yet.
finance.readonly: You can look at the finances, but only editors can change them.
finance.name: Name

compare.title: Comparison
compare.deltaHint: Ø = average of the completed months. The percentages show how “{{first}}” differs from each column.

benchmark.title: Statistic average
benchmark.help: Figures the overview shows your months against, e.g. the household spending of a statistics office. Each amount is a range per month in {{currency}}, from the lower to the upper households; one end alone is a single average. Leave out what you don't know. Not set, the overview doesn't show it.
benchmark.label: Source
benchmark.labelPlaceholder: e.g. Federal Statistical Office 2024, couple with 2 children
benchmark.invalid: Amounts must be numbers of at least 0, “from” not above “to”.

finance.categoryDeleteConfirm:
Delete the category “{{name}}”?

Its transactions stay, without a category. Its subcategories move up to the top level.
finance.subcategoryDeleteConfirm:
Delete the category “{{name}}”?

Its transactions and subcategories move to “{{parent}}”.
finance.mappingsHelp: How the columns of a bank's CSV files map, remembered by their header row. Remove one to set it up again on the next import.
finance.noMappings: None yet: the import remembers the format of a bank's files.
finance.clearHelp: Deletes all transactions, accounts, categories and saved bank formats of this family and resets the currency. The calendar stays as it is.
finance.clearConfirm:
Delete all finance data?

All transactions, accounts, categories and saved bank formats are deleted for everyone in this family. This can't be undone — export the family first if you might need them again.

import.title: Import a bank statement
import.help: Export the transactions from your online banking as a CSV file and pick it here. Rows that were imported before are skipped.
import.skipped_one: {{count}} row without a date or amount – skipped
import.skipped_other: {{count}} rows without a date or amount – skipped
import.remember: Remember this format for the next statement
import.autoTransfers: Combine transfers and split bookings automatically

finance.importedNone: Nothing new: all {{n}} were already there
finance.accountsHelp: Your bank accounts, cash or cards. A transaction can belong to one; the balance is the opening balance plus all of its transactions.
finance.accountDeleteConfirm:
Delete the account “{{name}}”?

All its transactions are deleted too. This can't be undone.
finance.transferAmountHint: Part of a transfer: it counts only once, as the sum of its bookings
finance.combineZero: Adds up to 0: it won't count as income or expense.
finance.combineIncome: It will count once, as {{amount}} of income.
finance.combineExpense: It will count once, as {{amount}} of expenses.
finance.findTransfersHelp: The same amount leaving one of your accounts and arriving in another within a few days. Combined, the two count as nothing: the money stayed in the family.
finance.noSuggestions: No likely transfers in this period. A transfer is the same amount going out of one account and into another, at most 4 days apart.
finance.autoCombineHelp: Combine every split booking with its parts (e.g. an order's items, also booked one by one) and every likely transfer between your accounts in this period, without a review
finance.nothingToCombine: No transfers or split bookings found
finance.splitAmountHint: Split booking: it counts only through its parts and what they leave over
finance.combineSplitHelp: {{name}} ({{amount}}) becomes the booking, the others its parts: they count on their own, the booking only with what they leave over
finance.combineSplitBlocked: Only transactions that aren't in a transfer or a split booking yet can be combined
finance.combineTransferBlocked: Parts and split bookings can't be in a transfer
finance.unsplitPart: Take out of the split booking
finance.unsplitPartDone: Taken out of the split booking

groceries.title: Groceries
groceries.help: The category of your grocery shopping (with its subcategories): a shopping list shows what was spent in it on its shopping day (± 1 day), and those transactions link to the list.

categorize.help: Sort this period's uncategorized transactions into your categories: like similar earlier ones, the rest with AI (it may look up unknown payees on the web)
categorize.helpSimilar: Sort this period's uncategorized transactions like similar earlier ones (set up the assistant to sort the rest too)
categorize.onImport: Sort the new transactions into categories (like similar ones, the rest with AI)
categorize.onImportSimilar: Sort the new transactions into categories like similar earlier ones

aiSettings.editorsOnly: Only editors of the family can set up the assistant. You can chat with it once it is set up; it only reads for you.
aiSettings.endpointHelp: Any API that speaks OpenAI's chat format with tool calls. Everyone in the family uses this setup.
aiSettings.baseUrlHelp: Including the version, e.g. …/v1. A model on your home network works only if the server allows it (AI_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENDPOINT).
aiSettings.keyHelp: Stored encrypted on the server and never shown again.
aiSettings.keySaved: A key ending in {{hint}} is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
aiSettings.modelHelp: Load the list from the API, or type a model name. It needs to support tool calls.
aiSettings.contextWindowHelp: How many tokens the model takes at once. Empty: from the API's model list if it says, else 128,000. Long chats are condensed before it is full.
aiSettings.searchHelp: Lets the assistant search the web (e.g. for school holidays). Without it, it can still read pages you link.
aiSettings.allowWritesHelp: The assistant may change the calendar, finances, meals and appointment searches for editors (most changes can be undone). Off: it only reads. For viewers it always only reads.
aiSettings.privacy: Your messages and the data the assistant looks at are sent to the AI API you set up above.
aiSettings.agentHint: For other AI agents that use Ohana's API with an API token:
aiSettings.photosHelp: The meals module can make a photo of a recipe with an image model of the same API. Without one, the photo buttons stay hidden.
aiSettings.imageModelHelp: E.g. gpt-image-1 or dall-e-3 (OpenAI), gemini-2.5-flash-image (Google's Gemini API). Empty: no AI photos.
